look_here_first: Usually upright/ascending and hairy, with alternate lanceolate leaves and typically 5 yellow petals plus 10 stamens; confirm long hairy bumpy capsules.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Erect to ascending, often hairy, branching wetland herb; some parts may become woody.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, lanceolate and often visibly hairy, commonly short-petioled.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Typically 5 (occasionally 4, 6 or 7) yellow petals with stamens twice the sepal number.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Long narrow thin-walled hairy capsule, usually marked by small bumps corresponding to seeds.
